reference_description: The bar chart illustrates the quality scores for three categories: IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, represented on the horizontal axis, which is labeled "Quality Scores." The value axis, labeled "Scores," has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with tick intervals at every 5 units. Each category features two bars: a light blue bar representing "AvgObj" and a light orange bar representing "AvgSub," with values provided next to each bar. For the IFD category, the "AvgObj" bar reaches approximately 63.98, while the "AvgSub" bar is approximately 41.90. In the TagNum category, the "AvgObj" bar measures around 66.06, whereas the "AvgSub" bar is about 39.13. The DEITA category displays an "AvgObj" bar height of around 67.64, with the "AvgSub" bar at approximately 42.99. Horizontal dashed lines, colored blue and yellow, indicate "Base AvgObj" at approximately 64.71 and "Base AvgSub" at about 37.91, respectively. Along with these bars, two horizontal dotted reference lines are provided. The blue dotted line represents the (Base AvgObj) across all three categories, with a value of approximately 64.71. And the light orange dotted line indicates the Base AvgSub across all three categories, with a value of approximately 37.91. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors and the dashed lines for reference. A legend is placed at the right center of the plot, respresenting bar and line colors with corresponding score categories.
